## AGGREGATES

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
data_long %>% 
  filter(name == "water_stable_aggregates_mwd") %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = plot, y = value, color = horizon))+
  geom_point(size = 4)+
  facet_wrap(~horizon)+
  labs(y = "stable aggregates mwd")
```

## MINERALOGY

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
data_long %>% 
  filter(name == "mica") %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = plot, y = value * 100, color = horizon))+
  geom_point(size = 4)+
  facet_wrap(~horizon)+
    labs(y = "mica, %") 
```
